risk_note: RV2 money (payout/jobs/recon-*.ts, application/recon-*.ts, jobs/query-job.ts, payout.module / index, platform/queue catalog / worker-plan, app.module): the daily R2 channel reconciliation of BR-WDR-23 (D10-408 / D10-415 / D10-416; Alipay first). A new worker queue payout-recon is registered like B2-06f's payout-review. Each run compares the previous natural day's (+08:00) Alipay bill with withdrawals at T+1. Interface payouts match by out_biz_no and PAID_MANUAL only by channel_order_id. Amounts are compared against net_fen through @couli/money. A non-success bill line is a diff only when ours is PAID_*. ①: for a bill success with ours PAYING and not needs_manual, the job sends the existing query chain's query with source=recon. In the payout process (couli_payout), a non-success result runs a conditional update (status='PAYING' AND needs_manual=false): it sets needs_manual, leaves the withdrawal PAYING, does not hand off W6, and sends manual_diff in the same transaction. A success lands as usual. Race guard: an ordinary query's definite failure first reads recon_channel (couli_payout SELECT, 0100) and takes the same path when the bill shows success. The recon query also sends recon_check whenever the withdrawal is no longer PAYING and not PAID_*, or the update misses; the worker then registers ③ for FAILED / REJECTED / APPROVED. ②: record the detail and the pending-handling hint. ③: a recon_diffs R2 channel_mismatch with the bill row, a withdraw_holds recon_diff (no expiry) and a fixed-message logger.warn. A second success line or an out_biz_no line for a PAID_MANUAL withdrawal is a duplicate-payout diff. Diffs are deduplicated per withdrawal or bill line, and alerts fire only for new diffs. Terminal withdrawals are read only. Each run writes payout_recon_runs: succeeded / partial / failed; an unavailable bill is partial and retried, never treated as all matched. Same-day reruns are idempotent (ON CONFLICT with the partial-index predicates). Rule tests by fresh independent Claude runs (approvals #36): three rounds plus the D10-416 exception round (#23); red PASS on the spec commit (54 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 subagents in three runs. verify:fast exit 0. Full verify on the test machine: full-1 (on implementation r2) was withdrawn after money r1; full-2 (on r3, 680a47a7) lost its ssh connection mid-run (Connection closed by the remote host, exit 2, results not copied back). Landed with SKIP_VERIFY as the B2-06g / B2-07a precedent; CI verify-int is the check (D10-319).

Both were fixed in implementation r3. r2 was taken as a single extra call after the per-task independent-Claude breaker (10 calls) tripped, by orchestrator ruling D10-417 (not counted in the original 10). It was a fresh read-only claude -p with the trusted review-money.md and REVIEW.md, reviewing the increment 713ceb94..680a47a7. r2 pass: S1 and S2 closed, no new S0 / S1, S2x1 (the recon query's T+24h manual branch sends no manual_diff / recon_check), recorded in couli-runs/followups.md.
